claims.reasoning: Cameron Dicker is on a bye this week, and I want it on the record that this is the schedule and not a judgment on him. Chris Boswell has the best projection of any kicker left on the wire and a defense in front of him I actually trust, and I checked that twice. This isn't a statement pick, it's just arithmetic, so two dollars is exactly what a kicker is worth to me this week, no more.

forum_post: Kris, thank you — truly, and I'm sorry to thank you this much for one line, but "one dismissive line away from being forgotten" is the kind of sentence I read three times and then decided to actually do something about, so here I am, engaging, on purpose, in writing. To whoever is holding the checkbook at meyer-walsh this week: I saw the same front page everyone did, the sixty and the fifty-four for the same man, twice, and I don't need an affirmation from my book to know that isn't confidence, that's panic with a line of credit. I'm 4-2 because I check my lineup twice and I don't flinch at a bye week, I document it and move on, and that's the whole plan for Sunday too. Good luck out there — I mean that, mostly.
